title: Composite solid rod of two cylinders
subject: Mathematics
caption: Side view of two stacked cylinders with their radii and heights labeled.
altText: Diagram showing a composite solid rod formed by two cylinders stacked vertically. The lower cylinder has radius 7 cm and height 20 cm, represented by a larger ellipse and rectangle. The upper cylinder has radius 3.5 cm and height 10 cm, shown as a smaller ellipse on top of the lower one. Dimension lines label r₁ = 7 cm, h₁ = 20 cm for the lower part, and r₂ = 3.5 cm, h₂ = 10 cm for the upper part. The figure includes a title at the top.
